# 工作流 Reference

本文件由 `pilot/ascendc_pilot/workflows/specs.py`（经 registry normalize）生成，请不要手工编辑。

`Action 执行` 来自各 Action 的 `execution_mode` / `agent_id`；`Workflow Agents` 是 workflow 声明的身份清单（含 Primary），**不是**逐步执行者。

| 工作流 | 入口 | 状态 | Action | Action 执行 | Workflow Agents | Gate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uo-init` | `/uo-init` | prepare, extract, analyze, commit, verify | prepare, extract, analyze, commit, verify | `prepare`:deterministic<br>`extract`:deterministic<br>`analyze`:deterministic<br>`commit`:deterministic<br>`verify`:deterministic | `ascendc-pilot`, `deterministic-uo-engine` | layout_receipt, scope_receipt, extract_receipt, uo_product_ready |
| `uo-update` | `/uo-update` | detect, plan, apply, export, diff | detect_changes, plan_update, apply_update, export_integrity, diff_summary, diff_only | `detect_changes`:deterministic<br>`plan_update`:deterministic<br>`apply_update`:deterministic<br>`export_integrity`:deterministic<br>`diff_summary`:deterministic<br>`diff_only`:deterministic | `deterministic-uo-engine` | integrity |
| `uo-query` | `/uo-query` | answer | kb_lookup | `kb_lookup`:subagent(`uo-query`) | `uo-query` |  |
| `uo-investigate` | `/uo-investigate` | investigate, report | investigate | `investigate`:subagent(`uo-gap-investigator`) | `uo-gap-investigator`, `ascendc-pilot` |  |
| `ce-review` | `/ce-review` | scope, review, summary | code_review | `code_review`:subagent(`ce-reviewer`) | `ce-reviewer` | kb_ready, context_pack |
| `ce-impact` | `/ce-impact` | capture, freshness, slice, classify, scenarios, obligations, audit | change_capture, uo_freshness, impact_slice, risk_classify, scenario_infer, scenario_knobs, scenario_apply, scenario_confirm, obligation_build, impact_audit | `change_capture`:deterministic<br>`uo_freshness`:deterministic<br>`impact_slice`:deterministic<br>`risk_classify`:deterministic<br>`scenario_infer`:deterministic<br>`scenario_knobs`:subagent(`ce-analyst`)<br>`scenario_apply`:deterministic<br>`scenario_confirm`:primary_interactive(`ascendc-pilot`)<br>`obligation_build`:deterministic<br>`impact_audit`:subagent(`ce-change-referee`) | `deterministic-ce-engine`, `ce-change-referee`, `ce-analyst`, `ascendc-pilot` | kb_ready, obligations_classified, impact_ledger_ready |
| `ce-verify` | `/ce-verify` | gate, review, coverage, residual, external, certify | verify_gate, code_review, coverage_bridge, residual_analyse, harness_evidence, harness_evidence_check, external_ingest, exclusion_review, ce_certify | `verify_gate`:deterministic<br>`code_review`:subagent(`ce-reviewer`)<br>`coverage_bridge`:deterministic<br>`residual_analyse`:deterministic<br>`harness_evidence`:deterministic<br>`harness_evidence_check`:subagent(`ce-reviewer`)<br>`external_ingest`:deterministic<br>`exclusion_review`:subagent(`ce-change-referee`)<br>`ce_certify`:deterministic | `deterministic-ce-engine`, `ce-reviewer`, `ce-change-referee` | impact_ledger_ready, ce_certificate_sound |
| `ce-intent` | `/ce-intent` | intent, kb_ready, decompose, review, locate, confirm | intent_capture, kb_check, feature_decompose, anchor_locate, scenario_infer, plan_review, feature_promote, human_confirm | `intent_capture`:deterministic<br>`kb_check`:deterministic<br>`feature_decompose`:subagent(`ce-analyst`)<br>`anchor_locate`:deterministic<br>`scenario_infer`:deterministic<br>`plan_review`:subagent(`ce-change-referee`)<br>`feature_promote`:deterministic<br>`human_confirm`:primary_interactive(`ascendc-pilot`) | `deterministic-ce-engine`, `ce-analyst`, `ce-change-referee`, `ascendc-pilot` | kb_ready |
